name: Nationaler Emissionszertifikatehandel certificate value
law: NEHG 2022 § 10 (1): certificate value of 55 euro per tonne of CO2 in 2025. Fuel suppliers pay it for the CO2 their fuel emits and pass it on in the fuel price.

sources.title: NEHG 2022 (RIS, consolidated, Fassung vom 12.11.2026) § 10 (1): certificate values by calendar year; RIS refuses the workflow, so read in Chrome (tools/tables/browser/at-nehg-10.txt)
